provenance.note: Decoration only, conformed to the park_islands bake; rebuild after a re-bake. Procedural, authored in this repository from Blender bmesh sheets; no external mesh. No -col mesh: the stamped terrain stays the only collider. banded sandstone ledges along both wall bands, cobble scatter on the floor margins, varnish streaks. Flush lane: nothing inside a ride row's footprint stands over 0.12 m above the ground, so the rims carry no rocks or tufts and each detail shell is one flat 0.4 m patch.
